answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the thread is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the walnut of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
